features.name: Model selector
features.purpose: Pick which Claude model a session or workflow step runs with, shown with a one-line description per option.
businessRules: description is optional on ModelOption; missing description renders label-only
architecturalRules: all model Selects must use modelSelectData()/renderModelOption instead of inlining data mapping

features.name: Session sidebar usage display
features.purpose: Show per-session cost, token spend, and EU-formatted date in the sidebar session list.
businessRules: cost rendered as $X.XX, hidden when totalCostUsd is unset
token icon/tooltip hidden when totalTokens is unset
date rendered en-GB (dd/mm/yyyy) instead of browser-default locale
architecturalRules: totalTokens accumulates on the SDK result message the same way totalCostUsd already does, rather than introducing a separate tracking mechanism
